historical_pattern.summary: MST-wi metamorphic relation: dropping the session cookie must not preserve a privileged response body.

entrypoints: HTTP object GET with vs without Cookie

invariant: If a privileged body is visible with a session cookie, the same path without a cookie must not keep that body.

oracle.success_means: cookie-drop still returned the privileged secret

severity_rationale: A metamorphic relation that fails is an authorization break independent of a single labelled test.
